programme.title: As An Eilean (From the Island)
programme.desc: Scottish drama in which a gifted boy who is preparing to leave his island home to go to university on the mainland falls madly in love with a girl from the neighbouring village. Similarly, his teacher, involved in a photographic study of village life, becomes preoccupied with the young island nurse. Together the stories reflect the fragile balance of human relationships in an isolated rural community.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Psalm 91 air a sheinn le Còisir Ghàidhlig Bhaile Ghobhainn, an laoidh 'Reul Àlainn a' Chuain' le Kathleen Ghreumach agus bidh Mairead NicSuain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Govan Gaelic Choir sings Psalm 91, Kathleen Graham sings the hymn 'Reul Àlainn a' Chuain' and Margaret MacSween tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor takes on grannie’s recipe for rhubarb and orange jam, using his own home-grown rhubarb.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha Erica Nic a’ Phearsain air ais a’ toirt cruth-atharrachadh àlainn air seòmaran agus toglaichean le a dealbhachadh sònraichte. Leanaidh sinn i bho thoiseach gu deireadh phròiseactan is sinn a’ faicinn gach pàirt den phròiseas, bho phlana air pàipear gu bhith a’ trusadh stuthan airson crìoch snasail a chur orra. Interior designer Erica MacPherson is back transforming rooms, homes and businesses. We follow her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: Calum starts his underground tour in the north west of Scotland. With help from local experts, he explores the incredible cave networks of Applecross. Looking at how man has harnessed underground resources, Calum explores the Nevis Tunnels, the aluminium smelter in Fort William and the globally unique Lochaline sand mine. Tha Calum a’ tòiseachadh air a thuras fon talamh ann an Iar-thuath na h-Alba. Le cuideachadh bho eòlaichean-uamha ionadail, rannsachaidh e lìonraidhean uamhan iongantach na Comraich. Chithear mar a tha mac an duine air feum a dhèanamh de ghoireasan fon talamh fhad ’s a nì Calum rannsachadh air Tunailean Nibheis agus leaghadair aluiminium a’ Ghearasdain, cho math ri mèinne gainmhich ann an Loch Àlainn a tha gun shamhail san t-saoghal. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke – An Còcaire Fiadhain – a’ rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha Liusaidh a’ toirt Màiri Anna dhachaigh gu dùthaich a h-òige, Shropshire, far an do thòisich a beatha an co-bhuinn ri nàdar. Tha iad a’ trusadh bhalgan-buachair nach gabh a lorg an Gàidhealtachd na h-Alba, agus a’ dèanamh picil leotha. Tha iad a’ beachdachadh air àrainneachd gu math eadar-dhealaichte bho an dachaigh an Alba le taic bho athair Liusaidh, a’ tadhal air darach a tha co-dhiù 800 bliadhn’ a dh’aois, agus a’ trusadh eidheann-thalmhainn, lus cùbhraidh a tha càirdeach do phionnd is sèids. Agus tha an còmhnaidh ùine ann airson basgaid ùir. Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke -forage for nature’s bounty. Lucy takes Mary Ann to Shropshire where she grew up and began her life in harmony with nature. They collect fungi that can’t be found in Highland Scotland and pickle them. With some help from Lucy’s dad, they visit an 800-year-old oak tree and forage for ground ivy, a fragrant herb related to mint and sage. And there’s always time for a new basket. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Caileag nan Eun
programme.desc: Tha Caitlin na boireannach òg a th’air a beò-ghlacadh le bhith a’ coimhead air eòin. Nuair a smaoineachas sinn air a’ chur-seachad seo is mathaid nach e òigridh a’ chiad fheadhainn a thig a-steach oirnn - ach tha Caitlin airson seo atharrachadh. Mar sin, tha i a’ falbh air turas mòr mun cuairt Alba, a shireadh daoine òga aig a bheil an aon ùidh rithe fhèin. Anns a’ phrògram seo cluinnear na sgeulachdan pearsanta acasan mu na buannachdan agus mun mhòr-thlachd a tha iad a’ faighinn às a’ chur-seachad iongantach seo. Caitlin is an avid birdwatcher, but as a young female, she goes against stereotype. Keen to connect with people who share her passion, she sets off on a road trip around Scotland to meet other birders who are defying the typecasts and to uncover some of the personal stories behind the hobby. Together, they share the joys and frustrations of birdwatching as well as the pure exhilaration in spotting a bird that means so much to them. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: A year after a major fire, archaeologists and scientists examine the battered stones of Notre-Dame in Paris.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le December ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform December in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha an teaghlach buthaid a' dùsgadh tron oidhche 's iad a' cluinntinn fuaim neònach! Dè th' ann ach losgann, air chall às-dèidh a chadal-geamhraidh! Chan eagal dha ge-tà, oir tha na buthaidean ann gus a chuideachadh dhachaigh! The puffin family are woken during the night by a very strange noise which turns out to be a frog trying to find his way to the pond after hibernation! He needn't worry, though, as the puffins are on hand to help!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Bernie glacte am broinn uamhag 's tòrr chreagan air tuiteam bho na stacan gu beul na h-uamhaige! Ge-tà, tha Oona 's a caraidean faisg air làimh gus a chuideachadh... ach an tig aca air obair mar sgioba gus Bernie a shaoradh? Bernie is trapped inside the grotto after a pile of rocks fall from the cliffs and land outside his door! However, Oona and her pals are on hand to help their old friend - but will they be able to work as a team in order to save the day?

programme.title: Meaban and Moo
programme.desc: Bidh Linda a’ tadhal air a caraidean Meaban is Moo sa bhothan aca gus dùbhlain spòrsail a chur romhpa. Seo tha i ag iarraidh orra trì diofar ghlasraich a lorg fhad ’s a tha iad cuideachd a' dèanamh deiseil airson partaidh Oidhche Shamhna. Tha treallaich gu leòr sa bhothan agus feumaidh Meaban is Moo a dhol a rùrach! Linda visits her friends Meaban and Moo at their hut to set them fun challenges. She tasks them with finding three different vegetables while they get ready for a Halloween party. Their hut is full of junk, so Meaban and Moo just need to have a good rummage!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le taic bho chàch, tha Pipp a’ dol na banrigh, le crùn, cathair agus parèid rìoghail. With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with crown, throne and royal parade.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach brònach nuair a chì e gun fheàrr le Maigheach a bhith a’ leughadh leabhar seach a bhith còmhla ris-san. Tha Tosg a’ moladh dhà e fhèin a chur ann an riochd ridire gaisgeil airson aire Maighich fhaighinn air ais. Tha an dithis aca a’ togail dràgon leis a’ bheachd gum faigh Sionnach buaidh air an dràgon, agus gun dearbh e a luach do Mhaigheach. When Hare would rather read her big book of fairytales than hang out with Fox, he fears he’s not exciting enough. According to Tusk, only by becoming a brave knight will Fox be able to prove the opposite is true. The two decide to build a dragon so Fox can beat it in battle and prove his worth to Hare.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon a’ faireachdainn nach eil sìon a' dol ceart dha, tha Dadaidh a' sealltainn dòigh dha air rudan a chur ceart! When Pompon feels that nothing is going right for him, Dadaidh shows him a way to sort things out!

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ leughadh Tuathanas Punc. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Jarret J. Krosoczka agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Niall Iain Macdonald reads Tuathanas Punc, written and illustrated by Jarret J Krosoczka and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag air a chlisgeadh mun sgrùdadh slàinte aige. Mr Krabs is too scared to get his physical.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach. Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha Flix 'son dearbhadh g’ eil easan na shàr chat feireil – dìreach mar athair, Zeno. Chan eil a nàmhaid, Burma, dol a dhèanamh chùisean furasta dha, ge-tà! Flix wants to prove that he’s an ultimate outdoor cat - just like his dad, Zeno. However his nemesis Burma isn’t going to make things easy for him!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Gealach na Durraige Guirme a' nochdadh, tha i a’ taladh dhurragan gorma a tha glè thearc, ach blasta, agus ma dh'itheas Gumbal tè dhiubh, tha a h-uile càil a' dol ceàrr! When the Blue Grub Moon appears, it brings out a very rare but delicious grub and if a Gumbal eats one, things go wrong!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Troig is Bonns a’ feuchainn ri Gumbal-sgluidseadh, tha tubaist ann is tha iad suainte ri chèile. Feumar obrachadh còmhla ach ciamar a gheibh na caraidean air adhart leis a seo? When Troig and Bonns try to gumblesplat, they accidentally get entwined. They have to work together, but how will the friends get on with this?

programme.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
programme.desc: Cùrsaichean ann an Lodainn an Ear, is coidse le comhairle. The 15th Redan hole at North Berwick and golf tips from Keil Beveridge.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Coinnichidh sinn ris an neach-ionnsachaidh Clare Coghill, agus tha Calum MacIlleathain a’ coiseachd tro shràidean Ghlaschu an tòir air ailltireachd Ghreugach. Joy Dunlop guides us through the first basic steps to speak Gaelic. We meet Gaelic learner Clare Coghill and Calum Maclean surveys the streets of Glasgow in search of Greek architecture.

programme.title: Cuirm aig Celtic
programme.desc: Ceòl is còmhradh bho cuirm shònraichte le Sian aig Celtic Connections. Anns a’ buidheann Ghàidhlig Albannach, tha triùir dhen na seinneadairean Gàidhlig as fheàrr – Eilidh NicCarmaig, Ceitlin Lilidh & Ellen NicDhòmhnaill – le luchd-ciùil eile nan cois gus an dàrna clàr aca a thaisbeanadh beò ann an dòigh nach cualas roimhe. Air a lìbhrigeadh le Megan NicGill-Fhaolain. Music and conversation from Sian’s concert at Celtic Connections to celebrate the release of their second album. The Scottish Gaelic folk group comprises three of today’s top Gaelic singers - Eilidh Cormack, Ceitlin Lilidh and Ellen MacDonald - who are joined by an extended line-up of musicians to perform the album live as never before. Presented by Megan MacLellan. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Tha Joy Dunlop a’ feuchainn ri deagh oidhche cadail fhaighinn. Joy Dunlop tries to get a good night's sleep.

programme.title: Transatlantic Sessions
programme.desc: Julie Fowlis agus Muireann Nic Amhlaoibh le taghadh ciùil bho dhà dheichead den phrògram ciùil cliùiteach, ‘Transatlantic Sessions’ còmhla ri sàr luchd-ciùil thraidiseanta is dhùthchasach à Alba, Eirinn agus Na SA. Anns a’ phrògram, taisbeanaidhean co-obrachail bho na ‘Sessions’ le Emmylou Harris & Mary Black, Rosanne Cash & Radney Foster agus na gaisgich Èireannach Andy Irvine & Dónal Lunny. Julie Fowlis and Muireann Nic Amhlaoibh present highlights from two decades of the legendary music show Transatlantic Sessions, featuring some of the biggest trad and roots music stars from Scotland, Ireland and the US. This episode features collaborative performances from Emmylou Harris and Mary Black, Rosanne Cash and Radney Foster, as well as Irish music legends Andy Irvine and Dónal Lunny.

programme.title: Mu Chriochan Hoil (Derick Thomson @ 100)
programme.desc: Cathy MacDonald speaks to a variety of poets about what inspired Derick Thomson, learning about the man behind the poetry.

programme.title: OMC!
programme.desc: A sketch show featuring a collection of comic characters, spoofs, warring acquaintances and a citizenship test that asks all the key questions. Written by and starring the very best in emerging and established comic talent. Featuring Iain Beggs, Darren Maclean, Carina Macleod, Claire Frances MacNeil, Hannah McKirdy, Lana Pheutan and David Walker. Includes the latest TikTok sensation, a visit from an angel and a glimpse into the future via a gifted cut-price fortune teller. Anns an dàra phrògram bho shreath ùr OMC! chì sinn tuilleadh sgeidsichean loma-làn charactaran èibhinn, suidheachaidhean neònach agus ‘spoofs’ gun shamhail bho na sgrìobhadairean is cleasaichean as fheàrr a th’ann. An turas seo leanaidh sinn rionnag TikTok ùr, bidh aingeal a’ tadhal air feadhainn agus bidh ban-fhiosaiche, Madame Valeda, a’ toirt sùil dhan àm ri teachd le comhairle eaconomigeach! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha socair a th’ ann air an eilean, latha math airson a bhith dìomhain. Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ crochadh hamag, is tha tòrr spòrs aca a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre. Tha na Boga-bogadaich a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre cuideachd, ach tha iad air an caith suas dhan adhar is a’ dol a-mach à sealladh. Càite an deach iad? Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ falbh a’ lorg nam Boga-bogadach. It is a lazy day on the Island. Abney, Teal and Neep put up a hammock and have a great time trying to get into it. The Poc-Pocs join in the fun but are thrown up into the air and disappear. Where have they gone? Abney, Teal and Neep go on a Poc-Poc hunt.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Grandad is in Gran's good books for tidying his desk, but he tells Stan that it wasn't him! Who are the mystery tidy-uppers and how did they get in? Tha Gran toilicht' leis an t-Seanair leis gun do sgioblaich e 'n deasg aige, ach e 'g ràdh ri Dan nach b' esan a sgioblaich e. Ach cò an luchd-glanaidh dìomhair, agus ciamar a nochd iad an seo?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Catriona Nic a’ Phì a’ leughadh Mar a Chuireas tu Leòmhann air Falach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Helen Stephens agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Catriona MacPhee reads Mar a Chuireas tu Leòmhann air Falach, written and illustrated by Helen Stephens and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ dol gu coinneamh nan Sgùdan Sporais ’son a’ chiad turas, is tha bràiste ri chosnadh. Tha i fhèin ’s a caraidean dol a sgioblachadh sa phàirc. Chan eil gnothaichean ag obrachadh mar a shaoileadh tu, ge-ta! Hilda goes to a Sparrow Scouts meeting for the first time, and there is a badge to be earned. She and her friends tidy up in the park, but things don’t work out as you would imagine!

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc: Tanith Rothach le taghadh a tha eagalach fhèin math airson Oidhche Shamhna, le slaidhm, braimeannan agus taibhse no dhà cuideachd! Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Nuair a tha aig Minho ri fuireach airson greiseag aig taigh Granaidh, chan eil a’ chùis ri còrdadh ris. Tha e taingeil, ge-tà, gu bheil Mango, a charaid, còmhla ris. When Minho has to stay at Granny’s for a while, he isn’t happy. He is, however, glad that his friend Mango is with him.

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha sinn a’ coinneachadh ri Coinneach Clogaid, Olaidh Orains – oh, agus tha sinn a’ tighinn tarsainn air comharra-clisge ann an àite neònach. We meet Coinneach Clogaid, Olaidh Orains and we come upon an exclamation mark in a strange place.

programme.desc: Tha Olaidh Orains agus Màiri Bhàn nan Casan Fada fìor mhath air spèileadh ach tha a gruag gam fàgail ann an snaimeannan! Olaidh Orains and Mairi Bhàn have lots of dance moves as they ice skate, but her long hair leaves them in knots!

programme.title: Serie A (BBC Alba)
programme.desc: Tha sinn ann an Turin le ball-coise Eadailteach le Torino a’ cluiche Como beò ann an Serie A. We head to Turin for live Italian football as Torino face Como in Serie A.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: In the Highlands and Islands, Calum explores the caves of Assynt, a Unesco global geopark, before travelling north to Orkney where there is a wealth of archeological underground sites. But it is also an example of the modern use of subterranean sites: oil to service the Scapa Flow naval sites was hidden underground in vast tanks beneath Wee Fea hill. The war theme continues as Calum visits a Cold War underground bunker in Inverness. Anns a’ Ghàidhealtachd agus na h-Eileanan, bheir Calum cuairt tro uamhan Asainte, geò-pàirc cruinneil UNESCO. À sin, thèid e tuath gu Arcaibh far a bheil beartas de làraich arceòlach fon talamh, ach cuideachd eisimpleir nas ùire den fho-thalamh a chleachdadh. Fo chnoc Wee Fea, tha na tancaichean mòra a bha a’ cumail ola ri làrach a’ Chabhlaich Rìoghail ann an Scapa Flow. A’ cumail ri tèama a’ chogaidh, ann an Inbhirnis tadhlaidh Calum air buncair bho àm a’ Chogaidh Fhuair. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha Erica Nic a’ Phearsain air ais a’ toirt cruth-atharrachadh àlainn air seòmaran agus toglaichean le a dealbhachadh sònraichte. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Jenna Cumming. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Jenna Cumming.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Psalm 91 air a sheinn le Còisir Ghàidhlig Bhaile Ghobhainn, an laoidh 'Reul Àlainn a' Chuain' le Kathleen Ghreumach agus bidh Mairead NicSuain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Govan Gaelic Choir sings Psalm 91, Kathleen Graham sings the hymn 'Reul Àlainn a' Chuain' and Margaret MacSween tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Meaban and Moo
programme.desc: Bidh Linda a’ tadhal air a caraidean Meaban is Moo sa bhothan aca gus dùbhlain spòrsail a chur romhpa. Seo tha i ag iarraidh orra trì diofar ghlasraich a lorg fhad ’s a tha iad cuideachd a' dèanamh deiseil airson partaidh Oidhche Shamhna. Tha treallaich gu leòr sa bhothan agus feumaidh Meaban is Moo a dhol a rùrach! Linda visits her friends Meaban and Moo at their hut to set them fun challenges. She tasks them with finding three different vegetables while they get ready for a Halloween party. Their hut is full of junk, so Meaban and Moo just need to have a good rummage!

programme.title: Leum Suas air an Sguaib/Room on the Broom
programme.desc: Tha Lìosaidh NicÌosaig, a' bhana-bhuidseach, 's an cat gu dòigheil a' seòladh air sguab. Tha a' ghaoth mhòr ag èirigh 's tha Lìosaidh a' call a h-ad, an rioban a tha na falt, 's an t-slatag a tha na làimh. Ge-ta, tha triùir charaidean eile a' nochdadh a bheir taic dhi. The witch and the cat fly through the sky on a broomstick. The wind picks up, the witch drops her hat, her bow and her wand. Fortunately, three more friends come to her aid. Can they rescue the witch from the dragon and will there be room on the broom for all?

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le taic bho chàch, tha Pipp a’ dol na banrigh, le crùn, cathair agus parèid rìoghail. With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with crown, throne and royal parade.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Grandad is in Gran's good books for tidying his desk, but he tells Stan that it wasn't him! Who are the mystery tidy-uppers and how did they get in? Tha Gran toilicht' leis an t-Seanair leis gun do sgioblaich e 'n deasg aige, ach e 'g ràdh ri Dan nach b' esan a sgioblaich e. Ach cò an luchd-glanaidh dìomhair, agus ciamar a nochd iad an seo?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is a charaidean gann de dh’airgead, is leis nach eil ann an airgead ach pìosan beaga pàipeir le dealbhan orra, tha iad uile a’ co-dhùnadh gun cruthaich iad an t-airgead aca fhèin, is gun ceannaich iad na thogras iad. Because they are a little short of money, and considering cash notes are only little papers with drawings on them, Petit and his friends decide to create their own money and buy anything they want.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Martainn Mac an t-Saoir a’ leughadh Am Balach a bha ag Ithe Leabhraichean. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Oliver Jeffers agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Martin MacIntyre reads Am Balach a bha ag Ithe Leabhraichean, written and illustrated by Oliver Jeffers and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc: Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra... Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: The beul gun phutan Lynette ag adhbharachadh cunnart airson Elaina. Ciamar a gheibh Belle, Sebastian agus na caraidean air cùisean a shàbhaladh? Lynette’s loose lips puts Elaina in danger. How can Belle, Sebastian and the gang save the day?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Leis an tuathanach agus Bitzer a' falbh a-mach airson latha còmhla ri chèile, tha Seonaidh a' gabhail a' chothruim a bhith os cionn ghnothaichean. Ach tha e a' mothachadh gu math luath nach eil an obair cho furasta 's a bha e an dùil. When the farmer decides it is time he and Bitzer head out for a bit of man and dog time, Shaun seizes his chance to take charge. He soon discovers that the job is not quite as easy as he first thought.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha Flix 'son dearbhadh g’ eil easan na shàr chat feireil – dìreach mar athair, Zeno. Chan eil a nàmhaid, Burma, dol a dhèanamh chùisean furasta dha, ge-tà! Flix wants to prove that he’s an ultimate outdoor cat - just like his dad, Zeno. However his nemesis Burma isn’t going to make things easy for him!

programme.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
programme.desc: Cùrsaichean ann an Lodainn an Ear, is coidse le comhairle. The 15th Redan hole at North Berwick and golf tips from Keil Beveridge.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop a’ leantainn oirre gar toirt tro thuilleadh cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Joy Dunlop continues to guide us through further steps to speak Gaelic.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up, before they head along one of Tiree’s most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him. Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sa bhaile san d’rugadh e mas dèan iad air tè de na tràighean as iomraitiche ann an Tiriodh. Meòirichidh Iain air làithean òige agus na daoine bu mhotha a thug buaidh air a bheatha. Leis cho cudromach ‘s a tha ceòl air eilean Thiriodh, innsidh Iain man bhuaidh a bh’aige seo air fhèin agus mar a chuidich e a bhith cho soirbheachail le cluich a’ bhogsa. Bidh an dà chuid a mheas air an eilean agus a mhoit man aon taigh-stàile san eilean fhaighinn stèidhichte follaiseach. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: The vast landscape of the Cairngorms attracts thousands each year. Coinneach Rankin sets out on a multi-day expedition to learn why its vast mountains are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb, and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s. Tàlaidh cruth-tìre aibheiseach a’ Mhonaidh Ruaidh na mìltean gach bliadhna. Cuiridh Coinneach MacFhraing aghaidh air turas grunn làithean gus tuigsinn carson a tha sreapadairean, luchd-coise agus eile cho measail air na beanntan seo. An cuideachd deagh charaid, thèid Coinneach na dheann suas tè de na beanntan as àirde an Alba, dìreidh e slighe-sreapa fhada agus cuiridh e seachad na h-oidhche ann am bothan a thogadh ‘sna seasgadan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: A year after a major fire, archaeologists and scientists examine the battered stones of Notre-Dame in Paris.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le December ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform December in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: The ordered tranquillity of life in St Mary Mead is shattered by a mysterious discovery. Miss Marple's investigations lead her to a seaside hotel where some rather unusual people are staying.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Wildlife documentary featuring the fascinating lives of Britain's beautiful butterflies, filmed in exquisite detail and celebrating their enduring appeal to the British people. Butterfly-costumed carnival-goers dance at Notting Hill, street artist Nick Walker uses their image to brighten bare city walls, burlesque dancer Vicky Butterfly recreates butterfly dances, and women reveal their butterfly body art at Britain's biggest tattoo convention. Britain's butterflies have never been so threatened - three-quarters are in decline. But do they still have a message for us? A search for butterflies leads to some of the most beautiful parts of Britain. It opens up the intriguing possibility that a passion for butterflies could help us preserve the landscapes that we love.

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: Michael Palin undertakes a 50,000-mile journey around the Pacific Rim through 18 countries. On arriving in Japan, he tracks down the country's most loyal Monty Python fan, visits a reproduction Dutch village and stands on the site of the epicentre of the Nagasaki atom bomb. In South Korea, however, he faces obstacles to his trip and must find an alternative route to China.

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: Fusing biography, art and the history of fashion, Amber Butchart explores the lives of historical figures through the clothes they wore. She looks at Edward the Black Prince.

programme.title: BBC Young Musician
programme.desc: It’s a make-or-break moment for the musicians as the competition reaches its penultimate stage - the semi-final. With only three places available in the final, the pressure mounts for the five remaining participants. They must impress the judges like never before. Returning to the judging panel are world-renowned pianist and recording artist Joanna MacGregor, and conductor and broadcaster Ben Gernon. Joining them is superstar violinist Jennifer Pike, who shot to fame in 2002 when she won the title BBC Young Musician aged just 12. She trades the international stage for a seat on the jury for the evening. Who will the judges decide has the potential to perform a full concerto in the final and take a step closer to claiming a place in the BBC Young Musician hall of fame? Petroc Trelawny presents highlights from the semi-final filmed at Swansea University’s Bay Campus.

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: A 30-year-old Shakespeare is at the top of his game: he’s got a job at England’s best theatre company, the Lord Chamberlain’s Men, and the money is rolling in. Determined to restore his family’s reputation, Shakespeare works harder than ever, producing hit after hit: A Midsummer Night’s Dream, Henry IV and Julius Caesar. But as his star rises, a series of tragedies strike. Shakespeare’s life, purpose and family are thrown into chaos, and he begins to question if his new life is worth the sacrifice.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: Sir Derek Jacobi looks back on the filmed version of Franco Zeffirelli’s famous 1960s production of Much Ado About Nothing - a performance that brought together Robert Stephens, in the role of Benedick, and his soon-to-be wife - the late, great Maggie Smith - in the key role of Beatrice. For years, this recording was considered to be ‘lost’ by Shakespeare fans and TV historians, until a copy was found in the US in 2010 and then restored. Here, Derek recalls how working under ‘Zeff’ with such an impressive cast made for one of his personal career highlights, helped in no small part by the presence of Dame Maggie onstage and the friendship they enjoyed behind the curtain.

programme.title: Much Ado About Nothing
programme.desc: Dame Maggie Smith stars in the 1967 screen version of Franco Zeffirelli's exuberant National Theatre production of Shakespeare's romantic comedy.

programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.desc: Join presenter and musician Owain Wyn Evans for a concert full of Halloween tricks and treats. The BBC National Orchestra of Wales, conducted by Ellie Slorach, perform music that is guaranteed to give you a thrill. The concert includes Bach’s gothic masterpiece Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Saint-Saëns Danse Macabre and the spine-tingling Rimsky Korsakov’s arrangement of Mussorgsky’s Night on the Bare Mountain. The orchestra take us to a world of magic and wonderment with film scores by John Williams, including Hedwig’s Theme from Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone, Flying Theme from ET, and the night wouldn’t be complete without one of the most forbidding and recognisable musical scores in cinematic history - The Shark Theme from Jaws!

programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands
programme.desc: New Zealand was one of the last land masses to be found and settled by people. Lush and fertile, almost everything brought here flourishes, often with surprising consequences. Told through the experiences of its native species - in particular, a charismatic and peculiar giant, flightless parrot - this is the moving story of the changing fortunes of New Zealand's wildlife since humans first arrived.

programme.title: The Latest Secrets of Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: The great history of Egypt is inscribed on its monuments, temples and tombs, but hieroglyphs – the written language of the ancient Egyptians – fell silent until 1822 when a young French scholar, Jean-François Champollion, became the first person to decipher their texts for over a thousand years. Champollion’s insights and the work of other scholars helped bring an entire civilisation back to life. Today, researchers are increasingly interested in the authors who created these hieroglyphic works. Near Luxor, we follow a new generation of Egyptologists as they unlock the texts inscribed inside a richly adorned tomb, revealing the beliefs and lives of the priests, scribes, painters, engravers and builders who created this grand funerary monument.

programme.title: Classic Mastermind
programme.desc: Magnus Magnusson presents the quiz programme from Bradford University. The specialist subjects are Captain Bligh, King Richard III, Shakespeare's English Kings and George Stephenson.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Panel game of word definitions and deceptions hosted by Robert Robinson. Team captains Frank Muir and Arthur Marshall are joined by guest panellists Sue MacGregor, Liza Goddard, Derek Jacobi and Julian Pettifer.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: 1996 saw the peak of Britpop, the divorce of Charles and Diana and England hosting the European Football Championship. It also saw the beginnings of a new TV genre, ‘docu-soap’, with Chris Terrill’s series Soho Stories. Armed with a single camera, Chris embedded himself in the heart of this multi-faceted community, charting their lives, work, relationships, religion and fears. Chris tells us how his career as an anthropologist provided the inspiration for the idea and how the invention of a new video camera made that a reality. He describes the stories he found: the last days of what had once been Soho’s thriving Jewish populace, its notorious sex industry, the rise of the ‘pink pound’ and the battle against crime. Tales told with warmth through the people living them, their guard down - Chris making friendships that have lasted to this day.

programme.title: Soho Stories
programme.desc: A coded bomb warning causes panic in the West End, but Danny the drag queen must practise his act.

programme.title: Soho Stories
programme.desc: We follow the fortunes of history student Gwen, training to be a stripper for a summer job, and Danny, an unemployed actor who is a drag queen at night.

programme.title: Soho Stories
programme.desc: Bespoke tailor Mark appears in a Saatchi & Saatchi ad, Gerard concocts erotic costumes for the Raymond Revuebar, and drag artist Danny buys a new frock.

programme.title: Ancient Worlds
programme.desc: In the last of the series, archaeologist and historian Richard Miles examines the rise and fall of the Roman Empire. At the height of its power, the Roman Empire extended the benefits of its civilisation to 60 million citizens and subjects in a swathe of territory that extended from Hadrian's Wall to the banks of the Euphrates. Even under the rule of mad, bad and dangerous emperors, the imperial system proved to be robust, buttressed by the support of elite families in the far-flung corners of the empire, whose loyalty was ensured by a system of cultural aspiration, economic opportunity and military coercion. But the material benefits of the 'good order' delivered by Roman rule provided its citizens and subjects with the security to ask profound questions about the meaning of life - questions that the pragmatic, polytheistic Roman belief system was ill-equipped to answer. Christianity grew to fill the spiritual vacuum at the heart of Roman civilisation, eventually claiming an emperor, Constantine, as its greatest prize. The City of Man would be eclipsed the City of God.

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: What makes sharks built for speed? How do snakes move without limbs? How do sugar gliders fly without feathers? The answer all lies in their skin. Professor Ben Garrod uncovers the secrets of how skin has evolved to enable animals to solve some of the most remarkable challenges on earth. To do this, Ben heads to the specialist flight centre at the Royal Veterinary College to analyse the way a sugar glider uses its skin flaps to stay aloft. He goes diving with sharks at the Blue Planet Aquarium and discovers that, far from being smooth, sharkskin is incredibly rough. It is covered with thousands of tiny teeth that make a shark hydrodynamic. Ben also finds out how the keratinised scales on snakes' bellies are the perfect configuration to allow them to move over virtually any surface they encounter.

programme.title: Gareth Edwards’s Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: Shire horses, lifeboat heroes and a rugby team who train on the beach are among friends old and new that Gareth and Maureen Edwards meet on a trip away to St Davids, Pembrokeshire.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Stately sitcom. Audrey upbraids Richard for not sponsoring a charity event in aid of a new scout hut.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth has decided that, instead of her usual gift to Richard of slippers, he should receive skis instead. When Richard protests that he has no intention of taking up the sport, Hyacinth responds that he can cultivate the correct image by strapping them atop the car and drive about with them occasionally.

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: In the second of this three-part series, Professor Robert Bartlett explores the impact of the Norman conquest of Britain and Ireland. Bartlett shows how William the Conqueror imposed a new aristocracy, savagely cut down opposition and built scores of castles and cathedrals to intimidate and control. He also commissioned the Domesday Book, the greatest national survey of England that had ever been attempted. England adapted to its new masters and both the language and culture were transformed as the Normans and the English intermarried. Bartlett shows how the political and cultural landscape of Scotland, Wales and Ireland were also forged by the Normans and argues that the Normans created the blueprint for colonialism in the modern world.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: The remarkable story of Kwame Brathwaite, the Harlem photographer, activist and cultural pioneer whose work helped define the iconic Black Is Beautiful movement. Across a career spanning more than seven decades, Kwame captured over 500,000 images documenting African American life, creativity and identity, while championing black pride through photography, fashion and grassroots activism. Featuring exclusive archive material and contributions from family members, artists and cultural figures including Alicia Keys, Swizz Beatz, Gabrielle Union and Jesse Williams, this documentary explores Brathwaite’s pivotal role in reshaping perceptions of black beauty and culture around the world.

programme.title: Light and Dark
programme.desc: Professor Jim Al-Khalili tells the story of how we went from thinking we were close to a complete understanding of the universe to realising we had seen almost none of it.

programme.title: How the Romans Conquered the Alps
programme.desc: In 15BC, the Emperor Augustus set out to conquer Germania, but to pacify this northern territory, he needed to control a direct route through the unconquered Alps. Despite its importance, little was known about Augustus’s Alpine campaign until researchers uncovered an ancient battlefield and the Roman Empire’s highest military camp at the Septimer Pass in the Swiss canton of Grisons. A team of archaeologists, forensic and ballistics experts reconstruct the campaign, revealing for the first time the route, weapons and tactics used to overcome the Suanetes. The findings reveal how Roman soldiers coped in the harsh mountain conditions to successfully annex much of the Alps in a single summer. This province, Raetia, remained under Roman control for 400 years.

programme.title: Building Sights
programme.desc: Architect Sand Helsel applauds Trellick Tower, a brutalist tower block in west London, designed by Erno Goldfinger and completed in 1972.

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Brian Cox continues his exploration of the solar system with a visit to a planet that dwarfs all the others: Jupiter. Its size gives it a great power that it has used to manipulate the other planets.

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: Marlow is getting better, and the different strands of his fiction and reality begin to occupy the same time and place.

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: The young Philip Marlow returns to the country railway station following his mother's death in London. Forty years on, Marlow the hospital patient still dreams about the homecoming and the frightening figure of the scarecrow that now erupts into the ward.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: Arts in Motion
programme.desc: Lucinda Childs performs historic and new works with her company at the Fisher Centre at Bard. Over six decades, she has reshaped contemporary dance through precision, repetition and formal clarity. Emerging from 1960s Judson Dance Theatre, collaborating with Philip Glass and Sol LeWitt, she has carved a path as a defining figure in contemporary dance and an enduring practice of total minimalism.

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: John Simpson, in discussion with the BBC's unparalleled range of experts across the world, analyses the toll on Saudi Arabia of ongoing attacks by the Houthis, explores whether the Japanese will end their post-war pacifism, and looks at the possible effects on English football of Manchester City being found guilty of breaching financial rules.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded looks at the surprising alliance between Meta and Apple, which raises one of the biggest questions facing the AI industry. As technology companies invest hundreds of billions into ever-larger data centres, the two Silicon Valley rivals are backing a different vision: powerful AI models that can run locally on advanced desktop computers rather than relying entirely on the cloud. For years, bigger AI has meant bigger infrastructure. Vast data centres now consume enormous amounts of energy, water and land, while communities around the world are increasingly pushing back against their expansion. But what if there was another way? What if businesses could run powerful AI systems from their own offices, on machines sitting beneath their desks? Host Marc Cieslak is joined by Dr Stephanie Hare, AI expert and author of Technology is Not Neutral, Ben Hatton, consumer technology specialist and AI commentator, and Nate Soares, AI safety researcher and author, for a fascinating discussion on whether Apple's hardware and Meta's open-weight AI strategy could signal a major shift in the future of computing.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Shaina Oppenheimer reports from Israel ahead of a closely fought election, asking why young Jewish Israelis are more likely to identify with the political right than Gen Z voters in many other countries. As first-time voters prepare to cast their ballots, we examine the forces shaping a generation's political outlook. Plus: BBC Eye explores how people in Gaza are trying to survive amid widespread destruction of the infrastructure they rely on across a summer of Israeli bombardment – despite a ceasefire that has been in place since 10 October 2025.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: For the second leg of his African adventure, Clive has arrived in Ghana. Sometimes called West Africa's 'golden child', the country is known for its deep history, miles of glittering beaches and rich culture. Clive’s first stop is the beachside capital of Accra, home to over two million people. It’s packed with vibrant art, bustling traditional markets and high-rise modernity. He heads to one of the world’s biggest second-hand markets to meet the designers giving discarded clothes a second chance. Inspired by his dressmaker mum, Clive tries a bit of sewing for himself. Once he’s kitted out with a great new look, he heads to the studio of Dancegod Lloyd to learn some moves from the man who turned traditional dance moves into viral hits and who starred in a Beyoncé video. Clive also picks up his paint brush to learn more about the unusual art of fantasy coffins, and he compares his mum’s Jamaican smoked fish with Ghana’s best as he meets the young chefs determined to turn Ghanaian cuisine into the next global trend.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Why are record amounts of money pouring into sport? The LA Lakers are starting the new NBA as the most expensive sports team in history after being bought for $12.5bn. Record sums have also been spent on the NFL's Seattle Seahawks and English Premier League teams Liverpool and Chelsea in recent weeks. Is it really being driven by the search for an AI proof investment? Sal Galatioto is the man billionaires call when they want to buy or sell a sports team and he explains why the prices keep on climbing. Leading TV sports rights executive Daniel Cohen, of Octagon Global Media Consulting, explains the impact this is all having on how we watch and how much we pay. Ben Thompson also hears from the billionaire founder and CEO of Fanatics, Michael Rubin, and how fans are continuing to splash out on replica shirts, trading cards and other merchandise.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: It's a landmark year for Poland's Baltic coast as the maritime city of Gdynia celebrates its 100th birthday. Gdynia sits on a stretch of coastline some call the Polish Riviera, and it's become increasingly popular as some holidaymakers search for less crowded and cooler alternatives to the hot and busy Mediterranean resorts. Reece Parkinson meets a new generation drawn to the maritime traditions of Gdynia, sees the remarkable revival of Gdańsk's shipyards and experiences the wild windswept beaches of the Hel Peninsula.

As the King prepares to embark on a tour of the Caribbean, we ask: how should the UK address its role in the slave trade? And after the TUC called on the government to introduce a social tariff on banks to ease the cost of some energy bills, we debate whether big businesses have a duty to help with the cost of living. programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: As the Paris 2024 Olympics get under way, Bargain Hunt is getting in on the sporting action! In a special show, two teams of well-known Olympians and Paralympians battle for golden gavel glory. Natasha Raskin Sharp referees Sally Gunnell OBE and Mark Foster on the red team and Dame Sarah Storey and Richard Whitehead MBE on the blue team. Coached by Danny Sebastian and Kate Bliss, these Team GB legends dash around a huge antiques fair in Nottinghamshire to find items that meet their sporting challenges. Sally focuses on an old camera but doesn’t snap it up, while Mark plans to get ahead with a giant Buddha! Meanwhile, Kate spots a four-leaf clover pendant, but there is nothing lucky about the price tag. However, there is an extra prize on offer in this special show: the chance to compete for the coveted Bargain Hunt Games Cup. Over three extraordinary events, the athletes put their skills to the test. Then it’s onto the home straight when auctioneer Richard Winterton champions their items to a packed room of bidders. Who will cross the finish line with the most money? And will anyone add a golden gavel to their trophy cabinet?

programme.title: Desmond Armstrong: America's World Cup Pioneer
programme.desc: Desmond Armstrong was the first US-born black player to represent the United States men's national football team at a World Cup. He was part of the squad that did the unthinkable: qualifying for Italia 90 at a time when the US had no professional league and football wasn't taken seriously. This documentary explores how he got there, the racial tensions of that era and his work as a youth academy coach in Antioch, Nashville, making the sport accessible to immigrant communities against a backdrop of heightened immigration enforcement.

Usually, scrap metal queen Mel would be the dealer to target, but with new dealers the Rag & Bone Bros in the room, she might face stiff competition. programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Emma, Dave, Lee and Jodie – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Matthew Perry and the Ketamine Queen
programme.desc: Documentary investigating events leading up to the shocking death of Friends star Matthew Perry and the woman at the centre of the case, dubbed the 'Ketamine Queen' by US prosecutors. Jasveen Sangha, a drug dealer and dual US-UK citizen, has pleaded guilty to five federal charges in Los Angeles, including one count of distributing ketamine resulting in death or bodily injury. She faces up to 65 years in prison for supplying Perry with the drugs that led to his death. Sangha was one of five people charged in the case. Prosecutors described her home as a 'drug-selling emporium', where authorities found approximately 79 vials of ketamine and other drugs, including methamphetamine, cocaine and Xanax. Presented by Amber Haque, the film features exclusive, first-on-the-record interviews with Sangha's friends and examines her role in Perry’s death and Hollywood’s ketamine drug network.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May conduct a valuable piece of consumer research with their attempts to improve and enhance the ambulance. Starting with a belief that current ambulances, which are usually very big and based on a diesel van, are in need of a rethink, the presenters go their separate ways to focus on the one area they think could be improved. May focuses on passenger comfort, Hammond tries to improve response times by getting other drivers out of the way more effectively, while Clarkson confronts the same issue with the invention of what he calls 'the sports ambulance'. Their three very different creations are then put to the test with a series of severe and often messy challenges, culminating in a fast reaction to a spectacular emergency. Also in this episode, F1 driver Daniel Ricciardo is the star in the Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson tests the new BMW M3 at the track before switching to another BMW, the space-age, hybrid-powered i8, for a revealing trip up the A1 to Whitby. When he gets there and is fuelled by a portion of fish and chips, Clarkson must decide which of the two cars he would rather take for the drive home. Also in this programme, Richard Hammond marks the imminent demise of the legendary Land Rover Defender with a heart-stopping attempt to drive one straight up the side of a dam. Meanwhile, James May makes a rare trip to the Top Gear track to test the brand new 500-horsepower Mercedes-AMG GT. The stars in the Reasonably Priced Car are actress Margot Robbie and Hollywood superstar Will Smith.

programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc: First World War soldiers try very unusual ways to cure frostbite in the winter. Plus the not-at-all-romantic movie starring William the Conqueror, Vincenzo Larfoff fails to scare us with the story of Aztec emperor Motecuhzoma, and a strange Stuart doctor takes a snooze in the middle of a battle.

programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc: A pirate chef disgusts the judges on Historical MasterChef, and a Stone Age man appears on Dragons' Den with his innovative inventions. Also, a look at the odd marriage of Mary I and Philip II of Spain, and the Victorian paramedics offer their bizarre medical advice to a modern patient.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: In this episode of the world's biggest car programme, Richard Hammond is dropped into the remote, frozen wastes of Canada to test a watch with a built-in emergency beacon. Normally, activating the device would summon a vast international rescue crew, but in Hammond's case, the distress signal is sent directly to Jeremy Clarkson and James May who are disorganised, disinterested and very many miles away. Eventually, the pair get their hands on two machines they believe are suitable for the job and set off on an epic adventure to find their colleague. Also in this show, Clarkson is on the track in the new 471-horsepower Lexus RC F coupe whilst star of The Fall and The X-Files Gillian Anderson tries her hand in the Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: Stacey Dooley
programme.desc: In 2021, 19-year-old soldier Jaysley Beck was found dead in her army barracks. Through unprecedented access to her family, friends and former colleagues, Stacey Dooley traces her journey from excited young recruit to victim of sexual assault. As her family seeks answers and fights for change, the film explores the experiences of women in the armed forces and asks what more can be done to protect them.

programme.title: Missing in Paradise: Searching for Sarm
programme.desc: On the night of 7 March 2021, Sarm Heslop disappeared from Siren Song, a luxury charter yacht in the Caribbean where she was living with her boyfriend, Ryan Bane. She hasn’t been seen since. Did Sarm vanish of her own accord? Was there a terrible accident? Or did something more sinister happen? Journalist Tir Dhondy investigates. Tir retraces Sarm's last known movements and tracks down two boat captains whose vessels were moored near the yacht she vanished from. And for the first time, she gets to question Ryan’s account of what happened through his lawyer David Cattie.

programme.title: Missing in Paradise: Searching for Sarm
programme.desc: On the night of 7 March 2021, Sarm Heslop disappeared from Siren Song, a luxury charter yacht in the Caribbean where she was living with her boyfriend, Ryan Bane. She hasn’t been seen since. Did Sarm vanish of her own accord? Was there a terrible accident? Or did something more sinister happen? Journalist Tir Dhondy investigates. Tir meets with island police and is given CCTV footage that has never been released, showing Sarm’s last known movements with Ryan.

programme.title: Missing in Paradise: Searching for Sarm
programme.desc: On the night of 7 March 2021, Sarm Heslop disappeared from Siren Song, a luxury charter yacht in the Caribbean where she was living with her boyfriend, Ryan Bane. She hasn’t been seen since. Did Sarm vanish of her own accord? Was there a terrible accident? Or did something more sinister happen? Journalist Tir Dhondy investigates. Tir searches for the yacht Sarm vanished from and tracks down Ryan Bane’s ex-wife, hearing first-hand about her experiences while married to him.

programme.title: Zara McDermott
programme.desc: This episode tells the story of Gaia going missing from her aunt’s house just before sunset on a November evening in 2017. Just before she leaves, she makes a last-minute call to her identical twin sister, Maya, then she runs. She’s alone without a coat, phone or medication for her epilepsy and in a state of high distress. After making several emergency calls to police, Gaia’s family believe that a widespread search for her is underway. Days later, after hundreds of volunteers have joined the search, Gaia’s body is found deep in undergrowth on Dancing Ledge. She had died of hypothermia. Zara McDermott wants answers; what or who had she been running from? And could the man that Gaia had briefly been seeing have anything to do with her disappearance?

programme.title: Zara McDermott
programme.desc: Three years before her death, Gaia was approached online by an older man. Zara McDermott discovers he was at the heart of a world of webcamming and online grooming in Dorset.

programme.title: Zara McDermott
programme.desc: Gaia was experiencing a severe mental health crisis on the day she disappeared. Zara McDermott discovers the final pieces of the jigsaw in the mystery that surrounds her death.
